js.title: J+S (Jeunesse+Sport)

js.exportHint: Two CSV files per offer and period (semicolon-separated, UTF-8): participants with attendance per session, and the session list with date, duration and coach.

js.ahvHint: Only with documented consent of the parents. Stored encrypted; only admins can read it and every export is logged.
